mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.15% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% over 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 700) and industrial production (INDPRO > 95) indicates robust consumer demand and supply chain strength, reducing uncertainty and boosting equity valuations for positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The condition (HOUST>700 and INDPRO>95) occurs in more than 55% of cases where 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% annualized), stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) support sustained equity market growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1 quarterly change) indicates expanding economic activity, increasing corporate profits and stock valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100,000) signals strong job creation, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 100000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in consumer spending (RSAFS > 390,000) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%) reduces borrowing costs and increases disposable income, driving positive equity returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition (RSAFS>390000 and FEDFUNDS<=0.15%) occurs in more than 55% of cases where 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 95 (INDPRO > 95) signals robust manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 95.
